playful.text: Wait... did you seriously just ask a robot for relationship advice? Okay, fine! Step one: stop texting them at 2 a.m. Step two... actually, that's it. That's the whole plan.

mockNews.text: Breaking news: local human discovers that talking to an AI is easier than talking to their own family. Experts are shocked. Family members? Not so much.

curious.text: Okay, quick question... if a chatbot laughs at its own joke in an empty room, does it still count as funny? Asking for a friend. A very lonely, very confused friend.
